LanguageData.CC_Settings_DrinkBeforeWork_Tip: With Alpha Skills: a colonist with the drunken passion in a skill learns it much faster while drunk. With this on, before work that trains that skill they usually take one drink from the colony's stores first (beer, or another mod's drink that makes them drunk the same way), then go on to the work. Only a drink their drug policy allows for fun, or a scheduled dose that's due, and their beliefs allow; never for a teetotaler, a child, someone addicted, pregnant or hurt, or someone whose tolerance is getting high; never in danger, never before tending, surgery, hunting or work with animals; at most once in eight hours, and only from a stockpile a short walk away. After three days running of it, now and then they go back for a second cup if their drug policy allows it for fun, and may stagger at the bench. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_DrinkBeforeWork: With Alpha Skills, a colonist with a drunken passion often has a drink from the stores before that work.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_SmokeBeforeWork_Tip: With Alpha Skills: a colonist with the stoned passion in a skill learns it faster while high on smokeleaf. With this on, before work that trains that skill they usually smoke one joint from the colony's stores first (or another mod's drug that gives the same high and nothing else), then go on to the work. Only a joint their drug policy allows for fun, or a scheduled dose that's due, and their beliefs allow; never for a teetotaler, a child, someone addicted, pregnant or hurt, someone already drunk or high, or someone whose tolerance is getting high; never in danger, never before tending, surgery, hunting or work with animals; at most once in eight hours, and only from a stockpile a short walk away. Smokeleaf slows the mind more than a beer, so a high stronger than smokeleaf's own is never had. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_SmokeBeforeWork: With Alpha Skills, a colonist with a stoned passion often smokes a joint from the stores before that work.
